# anthropic_service_account (Resource)

Manages an Anthropic service account (`svac_…`) — the non-human identity that [Workload Identity Federation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/workload-identity-federation) tokens act as.

Requires the provider's `oauth_token` (an `org:admin` OAuth bearer token); the Admin API key cannot access these endpoints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires the provider's oauth_token (an org:admin OAuth bearer token).
resource "anthropic_service_account" "inference_worker" {
  name              = "inference-worker"
  organization_role = "developer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the service account. Must match `^[a-z0-9-]+$`, 1–255 chars, unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `organization_role` (String) Organization role of the service account (e.g. `developer`, or `admin` for a bootstrap `org:admin` rule target).

### Read-Only

- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the service account was archived, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 datetime when the service account was created.
- `id` (String) ID of the service account (`svac_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing service account by its ID
terraform import anthropic_service_account.inference_worker svac_xxxxx
```
